## Summary

- Drop source-inferred `base_pr` metadata when the source PR is closed or merged so `/implement` starts from the default branch while retaining PR context.
- Add a base-branch note to generated tracking issue metadata and clarify explicit closed `base_pr` resolver errors.
- Update prompt/docs and regression tests for open vs closed inferred base PR handling.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/resolve-dispatch-cli.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/implementation-base.test.js .agent/dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js`
- `node --test .agent/dist/__tests__/triage.test.js`
- `node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const YAML=require('yaml'); for (const f of ['.github/workflows/agent-router.yml']) { YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); console.log(f + ' ok'); }"`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #305

Part of #314
